title: Boy in White Suit with Dog, Fullerton CA - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
817 A
FADE PROOF
SEP 6 1938
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
description: A crisp, full-length outdoor portrait of a young boy dressed in a formal all-white ensemble, including a collared jacket, trousers, and white shoes, standing in front of a white clapboard house with climbing ivy and a multi-pane window. A small black-and-white family dog stands directly between his feet on the walkway. The scene captures typical late-1930s suburban American youth and domestic pet companionship, stamped as developed in Fullerton, California, in September 1938.
